questions.question: The matrix $A=\begin{pmatrix}1&-2\\2&1\end{pmatrix}$ has eigenvalues $1\pm 2\mathrm{i}$. Which characteristic polynomial is consistent with these eigenvalues?
questions.explanation: $\det\begin{pmatrix}1-\lambda&-2\\2&1-\lambda\end{pmatrix}=(1-\lambda)^2-(-2)(2)=(1-\lambda)^2+4$.

The characteristic polynomial uses $\det(A-\lambda I)$, so each diagonal entry is $1-\lambda$, not $1+\lambda$; and the off-diagonal product contributes $-(-2)(2)=+4$, not $+2$.
$\lambda^2-1$ is not the characteristic polynomial here.
